description: Presidential Secretariat - Order, call out all the members of the Armed Forces for the maintenance of Public Order, w.e.f. 22.12.2019

While it names the President (Gotabaya Rajapaksa), it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel appointment, but rather exercises a legal power granted by existing legislation.
